## Progress

- Open [PR #88](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/88): check-in issues a waiting-room token in the same transaction ("A-07": a letter per doctor for the facility's day, a number per letter; a facility-day app lock + unique index, so 8 concurrent check-ins get A-01…A-08); the token shows on the board card
- TV sign-in without a staff session: staff with practice configuration add a display at /admin/displays and get its link once (`/queue/tv#token`; tenant + 32 random bytes, only the SHA-256 stored). The TV posts the token from the fragment (never a URL the server sees) and gets an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie limited to /v1/queue; a separate scheme and policy, so display sessions never reach staff endpoints and staff sessions never read the TV. Revoking refuses the next request; pairing, adding and revoking are audited
- `GET /v1/queue/tv` returns `{now:[{token,room,doctor}], next:[{token,waitMinutes}]}` for the display's own facility only (exact-field contract test; no names, initials, MRN, birth date or reason); the queue hub's push has no arguments, the TV refetches; a call-in reaches the TV in under 2 s (LongPolling and WebSockets); optional chime switched on at the screen
- P-05 page outside the staff app (no staff session or context calls; e2e checks every request it makes): tokens 48–80 px, light on navy (contrast-tested tokens), en/hi/ar with Arabic RTL, live/paused state in words; mutation-checked (12 server, 4 client); browser-verified on the real API at 1920×1080 and 1280×720 (en, ar, axe clean, no patient data in any response the TV received)
- Follow-ups (recorded shortcuts, not ACs): displays are managed by URL until device management in Settings (MDV-P0-012); waits are place in queue × slot length until the running-delay estimate (MDV-P1-030)

## Description

Tokens issued at check-in (prefix per doctor/room, e.g. A-07). TV route /queue/tv?display=… authenticated by a device display token (no user login) shows "Now: token · room · doctor" and "Next: token · ≈ wait". Large type, high contrast, auto-refresh via SignalR, works on a basic smart-TV browser.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The TV payload contains tokens, rooms, doctor display names and waits only; no patient names, MRNs or reasons (API contract test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Display tokens are revocable and scoped to one facility.
- [ ] **AC3.** Calling a patient updates the TV within 2 seconds and optionally plays a chime.
- [ ] **AC4.** Layout is readable at 3 metres (minimum 48px token text) and in Arabic/English.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
